name: comp-57
title: Inline Tags Input
description: A wide single-line field that holds several small outlined labels, each with its own cross, alongside a muted placeholder for adding another. Typing and confirming grows the row of chips.
use: People need to attach several short labels, keywords or recipients to one record while keeping them all visible.
avoid: It pulls in the emblor library, and the starting tag and vendor credit line are baked into the demo file.
a11y: Label and focus ring are wired up, but chip remove buttons depend on the library for names and no reduced-motion check exists. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A long rounded strip with a thin border sits on a dark stage, filled left to right by small rounded chips carrying short words and a tiny cross, ending in faint "Add a tag" placeholder text. A small label floats above and a dim credit line sits below.
behaves: Typing a word and confirming turns it into a chip that pushes the placeholder to the right; the whole strip gains a ring while focused. Hovering a chip and clicking its cross removes it, and the row reflows.
customise: The wrapper exposes no props; starting tags, placeholder and chip styling are set through TagInput inside the file, so new content means editing it.
weight: light: A few chips and one input, with transitions only on hover and focus.
demo: Label "Input with inner tags", tags Red, Design and Motion, placeholder "Add a tag", credit "Built with emblor".
polishWhy: A competent stock tag field; plain chips and a vendor credit line keep it ordinary.
